stories.headline: Alcaraz wins his first ATP Finals title in Turin
stories.summary: Carlos Alcaraz has beaten Alexander Zverev in the final of the ATP Finals, 6–2, 7–6(9–7). It is his first singles title at the season-ending men's tennis event. The tournament ran from 15 to 22 November 2026 on indoor hardcourts at the Inalpi Arena in Turin, Italy.

stories.headline: Márquez equals a record with an eighth premier-class title
stories.summary: Marc Márquez has been crowned the 2026 MotoGP World Champion. He finished eighth at the Portuguese Grand Prix, which was enough to settle the title. It is his eighth premier-class title, equalling Giacomo Agostini's record, and his tenth world championship overall.

stories.headline: A Hong Kong film takes the top Golden Horse award
stories.summary: The 63rd Golden Horse Awards took place on November 22, 2026, at the Taipei Music Center in Taipei, Taiwan. The Hong Kong drama film We Are Born Good won Best Narrative Feature. The awards honour Chinese-language cinema.

stories.headline: A tortoise of 194 gives up some of his secrets
stories.summary: Jonathan, a giant tortoise believed to have hatched in 1832, is the oldest known land animal alive today. Researchers have identified 287 distinctive genetic variants in him, linked to protection against the effects of ageing. The work was published in Science Advances.
